answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks by requiring a locked stake per identity: before a falcon or quill node may vote or earn, it must bond its own collateral. To sway the tide by flooding votes, an attacker must post a fresh bond for every fake node, so his cost grows linearly with each clone. Slashing then burns the bond of any node caught impersonating another. Mass impersonation stays unprofitable whenever the capital locked exceeds the control gained.
